channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Security advisory permissions are now generally available
item.description: GitHub added four custom repository role permissions that let organization owners grant repository-level access to security advisories and private vulnerability reports, so contributors no longer need repository administrator rights or the organization-wide security manager role. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23 release candidate
item.description: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23 runs a self-contained AI model on device CPUs to detect unstructured secrets in air-gapped networks without GPUs or external connectivity, and makes Dependabot wait three days after a package version's release before opening update PRs. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: ClawDOS — an AI coding agent for DOS
item.description: ClawDOS runs an AI coding agent on an IBM PC 5160 (8088 at 4.77 MHz, 640K RAM); 176 KB HARNESS.EXE handles all but TLS, and Turbo C compiles and runs PRIMES.C in 64 seconds, 26 spent compiling, linking and running. (ricapar.net)

item.title: AlterContacts — AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead
item.description: AlterContacts is billed as an AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead, yet the page currently displays only a CAPTCHA security verification, with no substantive content readable. (Product Hunt)

item.title: AI may have solved the most important problem in mathematics
item.description: Anthropic's Levent Alpöge claims that Claude has proved the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, and the article examines whether that claimed proof actually stands up.

item.title: The Hungry Butler Effect: Concealed Commercial Incentives in LLMs
item.description: Concealed commercial incentives embedded in large language models are the subject of "The Hungry Butler Effect," though ResearchGate's CAPTCHA security check blocked retrieval of the full body text.
